caseNameFull: Aubrey v. Mahoning Valley Sanitary District

opinions.text: The motion to dismiss as to the parties appellants, Aubrey and Callan, is granted, and the motion of Pauline Gottlieb for leave to intervene and to be substituted as the party appellant is also granted.
